Iran-related Designations; Iran-related and Counter Terrorism Designation Update; Issuance of Iran-related General License

Release Date
07/14/2026
Press Release Link
Treasury Intensifies Pressure on Shamkhani’s Expansive Illicit Shipping Empire
Recent Actions Body

The Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) is issuing Iran General License Z, "Authorizing Wind Down Activities, Limited Safety and Environmental Transactions, and the Offloading of Cargo Involving Certain Persons or Vessels Blocked on July 14, 2026."

Additionally, OFAC has updated the Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List.
